name: koinos-node-manager
description: CLI-first fleet manager for Koinos nodes

scripts.build: npm run --silent build:identity && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-electron-assets.mjs
scripts.package:electron: npm run --silent build && electron-packager . "Koinos Node Manager" --out=.artifacts/electron --overwrite --prune=true --ignore=^/.artifacts --ignore=^/tests --ignore=^/docs --ignore=^/assets --ignore=^/scripts/generate-electron-ui-fixtures\.mjs$
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:compiled && npm run test:electron
